diagnosis: Customer reports 429s during nightly batch around 02:00 UTC at 5,400 rpm sustained for 20 minutes. Account is on enterprise plan; rate limit increase above plan ceiling requires a capacity review. This matches the policy for escalation.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. I understand that your nightly reconciliation run is hitting 429 responses around 02:00 UTC at a sustained 5,400 requests per minute for roughly 20 minutes. Based on our documentation, requesting a rate limit increase requires a capacity review, and the metrics you provided (peak sustained RPM and the measurement window) are exactly what is needed. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist who can review your request and discuss options for raising the limit.
